return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died acquiring original Bonemeal')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4bb63))

 print('VilverinContinue bonemeal sample playerHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' magicka='..Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current..' targetHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current..' distance='..(target.position-self.position):length())
 if Actor.isDead(target) then print('VilverinContinue bonemeal source dead');return end
 local origin=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,65);local point=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,50)
 local dv=point-origin;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*dv.x-f.x*dv.y,f.x*dv.x+f.y*dv.y)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(dv.z,math.sqrt(dv.x*dv.x+dv.y*dv.y))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue bonemeal aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
end}}}}
